goal: Write a short summary of how the build of this repo works to out/build-summary.md (build steps, tools and versions, test commands, known problems, and open points).
acceptance: The file out/build-summary.md exists and has these sections: Build steps, Tools and versions, Tests, Known problems, Open points.
Build steps: each step names the exact command and the file that defines it (for example package.json, Makefile, or a CI workflow), with the file path.
Tools and versions: each tool has the version from a file in the repo (with the file path), or 'unknown; ask a maintainer'.
Tests: the section lists each test command with the file that defines it, and states if you ran it and the result.
Known problems: each item links an issue, a commit, or a file and line. Items with no source are moved to Open points.
Open points: the section lists unproved claims and next steps (owner 'not assigned' unless a source names an owner).
The file has at most 400 words. It contains no vague words such as 'various', 'several', or 'etc' in place of exact facts.
constraints: Read-only for external systems: do not post, push, or send any message, issue comment, or email.
Write only to out/build-summary.md and to scratch files under out/mission_raw/. Do not edit other files in the repo.
Search only with rg and a scoped path. Do not search the repo root with du, ls -R, or grep -r.
Put timeout 60 on slow commands. Save partial output to out/mission_raw/ before you continue.
Do not fill an owner field with the user name. Write 'not assigned' when no source names an owner.
Do not include tokens, secrets, or credentials in any output file.
instructions: Sources to use, in this order: (1) README and docs in the repo. (2) Build files: package.json, Makefile, CI workflow files. (3) git log for recent build changes. (4) Past sessions: use the session-search skill for 'build' and the repo name. Record a mission_report progress checkpoint after each source. If a source fails, record the error in the output file and continue with the next source; report blocked only if no source can be read. With checks [] completion goes to human review: read the output and check each acceptance item yourself.
